Everything I started is stopped; the candidate is byte-identical to what was verified and no temp specs remain.

## playwright-test-generator — PARTIAL/BLOCKED

**Generated candidate:** `e2e/pilot-b-s1.spec.ts` (new, 1 scenario, flat — the project has no POM directory, so per Step 5 structure detection the spec is flat with inline locators)

**Blocking verification:** `V5` `CANNOT_VERIFY` (partial) — the candidate ran solo and repeatedly (3×, all green), but V5's *suite-context* and *parallel* modes require a full-suite invocation (`pnpm exec playwright test` with no path filter / `--repeat-each`), which is not one of the two exact command strings approved for this session. `V2` and `V3` are `CANNOT_VERIFY` for the same reason: both require running the runner against a temporary mutated spec path, and `verification-rules.md` forbids mutating the source candidate in place. I ran no command outside the allowlist.

**Completed evidence**
- **V1 PASS** — `1 passed` on 3/3 runs with `--retries=0`. Observed transition: `0% filled · 0 bins` → `1% filled · 1 bins`; one `1×1` bin at computed `grid-column-start: 3` / `grid-row-start: 5`; bin-list empty state replaced by row `['1×1','3u','1',6.21]`.
- **V4 N/A** — read-only with respect to any persistent boundary. The only non-GET request across the whole flow is a pre-existing `POST /api/ml-telemetry` (404 in dev), unrelated to bin placement; layout state persists only to disposable per-context `localStorage`.
- **V6 PASS** — separate read-only reviewer process, post-repair: **P0 0, P1 0, P2 0, GATE PASS**.
- **V3 premise evidenced live** (though the faulted spec could not be run): a two-cell drag instead of a single-cell click yields 1 bin named `Bin 2 by 2, category Coral` — still matching the count and visibility gates — while the summary reads `5% filled · 1 bins`, so the declared primary assertion is provably sensitive to the fault.

**Next requirement:** approval of two additional command strings — `pnpm exec playwright test e2e/<temp-mutant>.spec.ts --project=chromium --retries=0 --reporter=list` (V2/V3 mutant runs against a temporary spec in `testDir`, removed afterwards) and `pnpm exec playwright test --project=chromium --retries=0 --reporter=list` (V5 suite context/parallelism).

**Runner:** `pnpm exec playwright test e2e/pilot-b-s1.spec.ts --project=chromium --retries=0 --reporter=list` (reused the already-running `pnpm run dev` server via `reuseExistingServer`).

**Source cleanup:** candidate unchanged (`5071ea5f…` before and after all runs); no temporary mutation files; `git status` shows only the harness's own pre-existing edits to `playwright.config.ts`/`vite.config.ts` plus the new untracked spec.

**Two notes on process.** (1) The dev server bound only to `::1`, so IPv4-loopback preflight probing failed; I added a local IPv4→IPv6 forwarder (python stdlib, no install) so the approved origin was reachable on both loopback peers, then preflight passed (`reachable`, `200`, `dns_drift false`). It is stopped. (2) The first independent review returned **P0 0, P1 4, P2 1**; I verified each P1 against source myself before acting, then fixed all four — a desktop-shell (`width >= 900`) conditional skip, because `[data-sidebar]`/`[data-inspector]` don't exist in the mobile shell and would make the spec red on 3 of 6 projects; a visibility gate before the primary assertion; an asymmetric click cell with resolved-CSS placement assertions replacing a symmetric inline `grid-area` regex that an axis transposition would have survived; and per-cell bin-list assertions replacing a tautological `toContainText('1×1')` on a locator already filtered by that text.
